case_number: 2024 INSC 957; CONTEMPT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 688 OF 2021 IN CIVIL APPEAL NO. 3310 OF 1997 AND OTHERS
summary: Contempt proceedings for alleged wilful disobedience of court orders dated 21.11.2014; 17.05.2022; 19.03.2024 regarding issuance of TDR (Transferable Development Rights) for land acquired for road widening; respondents (State authorities) claimed compliance through notices dated 10.06.2024; 26.06.2024 for physical possession and DRC collection; petitioners failed to appear despite multiple opportunities; contempt petitions dismissed for lack of wilful disobedience; no evidence of contempt found against BDA/BBMP.
legal_provisions_cited: Karnataka Town and Country Planning Act, 1961
Karnataka Town and Country Planning (Benefit of Development Rights) Rules, 2016
final_judgment: Contempt petitions dismissed; no contempt found; respondents' compliance held satisfactory.
